chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام:

That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله combined between the Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr salat with one adhān and two iqāmahs, and he combined between the Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ in residence without any cause, with one adhān and two iqāmahs.

key_terms.إِقَامَتَيْنِ: two iqāmahs, one for each salat
key_terms.جَمَعَ: combined two prayers together in one time period

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله combine prayers in residence without an excuse?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله combined Ẓuhr with ʿAṣr and Maghrib with ʿIshāʾ, using one adhān and two iqāmahs. It indicates the permissibility of combining prayers even while in residence and without a particular excuse.
